title: The Case of the Missing Fishhook

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — JUSTICE AND CONSEQUENCES (JUS-01 to JUS-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Everyday rules, disputes between neighbors, the elders and the council, making things right, losing a role, a night to cool down, wrongful suspicion and evidence that doesn't add up. Consequences are proportionate and never cruel; children get guidance; nobody goes without food, water or shelter; an accusation is not guilt.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: The village's oldest bone fishhook has vanished from the meeting post: keep searching, or let it stay a mystery.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The village's oldest and finest fishhook, carved from bone and used only for the first fishing of the year, has disappeared from its place on the post at the meeting place. (subject) was the last to see it. (friend) was the first to notice it gone. The elders have asked everyone. Nobody knows anything.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They search for days: the meeting place, the beach, the stream, and every hut whose owner agrees. Nothing. At last the elders declare that the hook is lost, that nobody is to blame, and that a new one will be carved. (subject) carves it. It's very good. It isn't the same. For years afterward, (subject) looks for the old one whenever (subject.he/she) walks along the beach.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: The elders decide not to search anybody's hut, saying that no hook is worth making neighbors suspicious of one another. The first fishing of the year goes ahead with an ordinary hook, and the catch is good. (friend) still wonders, sometimes, where the old one went. Some say a bird took it. Some say the sea. Nobody ever finds out.
